note: T Samantha (Soshage zh-tw 221) : traduction non officielle depuis le chinois. Termes officiels repris de Soshage EN par id (Judgment, Pious Blessing, Piety, Channel, Straight Curse, Instant...). Skill 4169 : texte anglais officiel.

trait.name: Sword of Judgment
base: Has [Light of a Thousand Prayers] and the skill [Sword of Judgment], and provides the skill [Sword of Judgment - United] to suitable allies in battle.
When an enemy in battle is inflicted with [Judgment], it counts as [Enhanced Judgment].
[Physical DMG] dealt counts as [Magical DMG]. Has [Jump]: can pass over allies, enemies, neutral characters and objects, and ignores the effects of [Burning] and [Frosty] tiles.

1: Increases ATK and DEF stats by 5%. At the start of battle, [Piety] increases by 30; before casting [Sword of Judgment] for the first time each round, [Piety] increases by 20.
Increases the final DMG of [Sword of Judgment] and [Revelation - Final Judgment] by 15%. After casting either skill, gains [Final DMG Reduction I] for 1 turn.
2: Increases ATK and DEF stats by 10%. At the start of battle, [Piety] increases by 40; before casting [Sword of Judgment] for the first time each round, [Piety] increases by 20.
Increases the final DMG of [Sword of Judgment] and [Revelation - Final Judgment] by 15%. After casting either skill, gains [Final DMG Reduction II] for 1 turn.
3: Increases ATK and DEF stats by 10%. At the start of battle, [Piety] increases by 40; before casting [Sword of Judgment] for the first time each round, [Piety] increases by 20.
Increases the final DMG of [Sword of Judgment] and [Revelation - Final Judgment] by 20%. After casting either skill, gains [Final DMG Reduction II] for 1 turn.
At the start of the action, gains 1 NRG. The provided skill [Sword of Judgment - United] costs 1 less NRG.
4: Increases ATK and DEF stats by 15%. At the start of battle, [Piety] increases by 50; before casting [Sword of Judgment] for the first time each round, [Piety] increases by 20.
Increases the final DMG of [Sword of Judgment] and [Revelation - Final Judgment] by 20%. After casting either skill, gains [Final DMG Reduction III] for 1 turn.
At the start of the action, gains 1 NRG. The provided skill [Sword of Judgment - United] costs 2 less NRG.
5: Increases ATK and DEF stats by 15%. At the start of battle, [Piety] increases by 50; before casting [Sword of Judgment] for the first time each round, [Piety] increases by 20.
Increases the final DMG of [Sword of Judgment] and [Revelation - Final Judgment] by 25%. After casting either skill, gains [Final DMG Reduction III] for 1 turn.
At the start of the action, gains 1 NRG. The provided skill [Sword of Judgment - United] costs 2 less NRG.
Increases the DMG multiplier of [Sword of Judgment] by 20%. [Revelation - Final Judgment] now accumulates a use at the start of every action.

22878.name: Path of Redemptive Suffering
desc: (Physical DMG) Leaps to the target location and casts the skill [Sword of Judgment].
[Auxiliary Passive]: At the start of battle or after using [Sword of Judgment], gains [▲Move I], [▲ATK III] and [DMG Reduction III] for 2 turns.

22907.name: Hour of Answered Prayers
desc: (Support) [Instant] Consumes 100 [Light of a Thousand Prayers] so that the next [Revelation - Final Judgment] descends immediately after being placed.
[Auxiliary Passive]: Every 3 action starts, accumulates 1 use of [Revelation - Final Judgment].

22838.name: Hour of Answered Prayers
desc: (Support) [Instant] Consumes 100 [Light of a Thousand Prayers] so that the next [Revelation - Final Judgment] descends immediately after being placed.
[Auxiliary Passive]: Every 2 action starts, accumulates 1 use of [Revelation - Final Judgment].

22906.name: Sin-Purging Blade
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 70% physical AoE DMG to all enemies within 1 tile of the target. After attacking, gains [Light of a Thousand Prayers] equal to 25% of the number of [Pious Blessing] the character has (at least 15).

22851.name: Sin-Purging Blade
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals 70% physical AoE DMG to all enemies within 1 tile of the target. After attacking, gains [Light of a Thousand Prayers] equal to 25% of the total [Pious Blessing] of all allies (at least 25).

22905.name: Revelation - Seventh Trumpet
desc: (Support) Makes every [Revelation - Final Judgment] descend immediately.
[Auxiliary Passive]: Whenever a [Revelation - Final Judgment] descends, this skill's effect triggers automatically.
After casting this skill or [Sword of Judgment], reduces the cooldown of [Revelation - Final Judgment] by 2 turns.

22834.name: Revelation - Seventh Trumpet
desc: (Support) Makes every [Revelation - Final Judgment] descend immediately.
[Auxiliary Passive]: Whenever a [Revelation - Final Judgment] descends, this skill's effect triggers automatically.
After casting this skill or [Sword of Judgment], reduces the cooldown of [Revelation - Final Judgment] by 3 turns.

22832.name: Revelation - Final Judgment
desc: (Physical DMG) Selects a tile and places [Revelation - Final Judgment], which descends after the character's 7th action ends (the current action counts as the 1st), dealing 777% AoE DMG to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target.
[Auxiliary Passive]: At the start of every odd-numbered action, accumulates 1 use of this skill (starts at 0).
When casting this skill, inflicts [Judgment] (until the end of battle) and [▼Move II] on enemies in range; the character gains [▲ATK I]. All effects last 2 turns.

22903.name: Revelation - Final Judgment
desc: (Physical DMG) Selects a tile and places [Revelation - Final Judgment], which descends after the character's 7th action ends (the current action counts as the 1st), dealing 777% AoE DMG to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target.
[Auxiliary Passive]: At the start of every odd-numbered action, accumulates 1 use of this skill (starts at 0).

When casting this skill, inflicts [Judgment] (until the end of battle), [Straight Curse], [Vulnerable II], [▼Bound Sight II] and [▼Move II] on enemies in range; the character gains [▲ATK II] and [▲Crit II]. All effects last 2 turns.

22894.name: Sin-Revealing Light
desc: (Passive) Before [Sword of Judgment] attacks, inflicts [Judgment] and [Vulnerable I] on the target for 2 turns.
[Sword of Judgment] deals 10% more DMG to enemies with [Judgment].

22855.name: Sin-Revealing Light
desc: (Passive) Before [Sword of Judgment] attacks, inflicts [Judgment] and [Vulnerable II] on the target for 2 turns.
[Sword of Judgment] deals 20% more DMG to enemies with [Judgment].

22891.name: Radiant Tempering
desc: (Support) [Channel] [Instant] While channeling, enhances [Sword of Judgment]: for each point of [Light of a Thousand Prayers], its DMG multiplier increases by 3% and its Crit by 0.5%, stacking up to 50 points; however, [Light of a Thousand Prayers] decreases by 50 at the start of the action.

22885.name: Radiant Tempering
desc: (Support) [Channel] [Instant] While channeling, enhances [Sword of Judgment]: for each point of [Light of a Thousand Prayers], its DMG multiplier increases by 4% and its Crit by 1%, stacking up to 50 points; however, [Light of a Thousand Prayers] decreases by 50 at the start of the action.

d: Gauge of [Light of a Thousand Prayers] points, up to 100.
At the start of the action, gains points equal to 25% of the total [Pious Blessing] of all allies (at least 25).

(Physical DMG) Deals 80% AoE DMG to all enemies in a cross within 2 tiles of the character (3 tiles wide). Before attacking, for each point of [Light of a Thousand Prayers], the DMG multiplier increases by 1%, stacking up to 50 points.
(Physical DMG) Counts as [Sword of Judgment]; its effects and DMG are calculated from the provider.
After casting, the user's [Piety] increases by 20 and the provider's [Light of a Thousand Prayers] increases by 20.
Only for non-summoned, controllable characters; usable once per team, reset at the start of each battle round.
Same category as the Tarot word [The Judgment's Redemption]. Debuff: increases DMG taken by 20%. Cannot be immune.
Marks a selected tile; after some time, the mark is removed and [Revelation - Final Judgment] descends: the caster deals 777% AoE DMG to all enemies within 2 tiles of that tile.
Control - Disruption. Reduces the max range of ranged skills by 2 tiles. Removed after actively attacking.
